wallets_subtitle: Every account the household holds, grouped by kind.
add_wallet_description: A wallet is one account at one institution, in one person's name.
edit_wallet_description: Change the name or who can see this wallet.
fixed_fields_note: Owner, institution, kind and currency can't be changed after the wallet is created.
name: Name
privacy_shared: Shared wallets are visible to the household's owners and adults.
privacy_private: Private wallets are visible only to their owner, and to adults when the owner is a member they manage.
no_wallets_body: Add a wallet for each account you hold — a brokerage account, IKE, savings or bonds. You'll record its balance next.
conflict_error: Someone else changed this wallet. The list has been refreshed — try again.
wallet_not_found_body: It may have been removed, or it is private to someone else.
pln_pending: The PLN value appears once exchange rates are available.
same_date_hint: Recording a date that already has a balance replaces it.
archived_balance_hint: This wallet is archived: you can correct existing dates, but not add new ones.
balance_save_error: Couldn't save the balance. Try again.
amount_invalid: Enter an amount such as 12450,10 — not negative, at most two decimals.
date_invalid: Choose a date that is not in the future.
balance_delete_error: Couldn't delete the balance. Try again.
delete_balance_confirm_body: It's removed from the history and the net worth. This can't be undone.
